title: Implementation Plans for Cashless Public Transport System
what_it_is: Implementation Plans for Cashless Public Transport System

sections.label: CEPAS card public transport fares
sections.summary: Over 98% of commuters use CEPAS cards, including EZ-Link, NETS FlashPay and LTA Concession Cards, for public transport fares, including almost 700,000 Senior Citizen Concession Card holders.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: More than 98% of commuters use Contactless e-Purse Application Specification (CEPAS) cards which include EZ-Link, Network for Electronic Transfers (NETS) FlashPay and the Land Transport Authority (LTA) Concession Cards, to pay their public transport fares.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: These include most senior citizens as there are almost 700,000 Senior Citizen Concession Card holders.

sections.label: Cash facilities additional costs
sections.summary: Maintaining cash facilities at MRT stations and buses imposes additional costs of almost $20 million a year.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: Maintaining cash facilities at Mass Rapid Transit (MRT) stations and buses also imposes additional costs of almost $20 million a year.

sections.label: Account-based Ticketing system pilot
sections.summary: The new ABT system lets commuters use contactless credit or debit cards to tap in and out, piloted for MasterCard holders from March 2017 with over 100,000 participants.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: This can be achieved through the new Account-based Ticketing (ABT) system, which will allow commuters to use contactless credit or debit cards to tap in and out of the public transport system.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: We have started piloting the ABT system for MasterCard holders from March 2017 and have since garnered more than 100,000 participants.

sections.label: Service agents help commuters
sections.summary: About 150 service agents, a quarter of them seniors, will be deployed over nine months to help commuters learn to use ticketing machines at MRT stations.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: For example, about 150 service agents, of whom a quarter are seniors themselves, will be deployed over the next nine months to help commuters learn how to use the ticketing machines at MRT stations.

sections.label: EZ-Link top-up costs
sections.summary: Commuters pay 25 cents for EZ-Link reloads by credit card or GIRO, or 50 cents at 7-Eleven, and MOT is hoped to work with partners to reduce top-up costs.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ang Wei Neng (Jurong)
sentences.text: First, I understand that, right now, commuters have to pay 25 cents if you do an EZ-Link reload using credit card or GIRO, or they even have to pay 50 cents if they go to 7-Eleven to top up the card.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ang Wei Neng (Jurong)
sentences.text: All these are costs and I hope MOT can work with their partners to reduce the cost of the EZ-Link top-ups.

sections.label: Two dollar bank admission fee
sections.summary: They have to pay a $2 admission fee to the banks when the banks are earning billions of dollars a year.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ang Wei Neng (Jurong)
sentences.text: As a result, they have to pay $2 admission fee to the banks when the banks are earning billions of dollars a year.

sections.label: Elderly basic banking accounts
sections.summary: Major retail banks have offered basic banking accounts since 2002, with ATM or debit cards and Internet banking, at very low cost.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: To ensure that the elderly have access to affordable and convenient basic banking services, many major retail banks have already offered basic banking accounts since 2002, and these accounts generally come with automated teller machine or debit card facilities and Internet banking services as well and can be maintained at a very low cost.

sections.label: Cash alternatives for transport rides
sections.summary: LTA and Transit-Link will ensure cash alternatives for transport rides, such as stored value card sale and top-up, remain near public transport.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: LTA and Transit-Link will also ensure that cash alternatives to paying for transport rides, such as those for the sale and top-up of stored value cards, remain available within the vicinity of the public transport modes to cater to those commuters who really cannot convert to cashless mode, for whatever reasons.
